overview: 本期共收录 7 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（5 篇）、收入分配与福利（1 篇）、货币政策与宏观经济（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、机器学习为主。来源分布：Semantic Scholar（5 篇）、OpenAlex（2 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: ANALISIS PREFERENSI KONSUMEN DOMBA PADA SEGMEN POTONG HARIAN DI KABUPATEN GARUT
papers.abstract: Kabupaten Garut memiliki populasi domba yang besar, namun keterbatasan data mengenai preferensi spesifik menyebabkan ketidaksesuaian produk di pasar. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengidentifikasi karakteristik dan preferensi konsumen domba pada segmen pasar potong harian di Kabupaten Garut. Metode penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif melalui survei terhadap 31 responden dengan teknik judgement sampling. Karakteristik responden didominasi oleh pria (96%), wiraswasta (87%), dan lulusan SMA/SMK (61%). Validitas stimuli diuji menggunakan Cochran-Q yang menghasilkan 8 stimuli relevan, dilanjutkan dengan analisis konjoin untuk membedah preferensi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan konsumen potong harian mengutamakan domba muda berusia di bawah satu tahun, memiliki bobot 25–35 kg, serta kisaran harga Rp1.500.000 hingga Rp2.100.000. Temuan ini menyimpulkan bahwa efisiensi usaha dalam segmen potong harian sangat ditentukan oleh usia ternak dan harga yang terjangkau. Penelitian ini memberikan kontribusi pada pengembangan strategi pemasaran peternakan berbasis segmen pasar yang akurat.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】加鲁特县（Kabupaten Garut）拥有庞大的羊群数量，但由于关于消费者具体偏好的数据有限，导致市场上提供的产品无法满足消费者的需求。本研究旨在了解加鲁特县日常肉类消费市场的消费者特征及其偏好。研究采用定量方法，通过对31名受访者进行调查来完成（抽样方法为判断抽样）。受访者主要为男性（96%）、私营企业主（87%）以及高中/中专毕业生（61%）。通过Cochran-Q检验对调查材料的有效性进行了验证，最终确定了8个与消费者偏好相关的因素，并通过联合分析（conjoint analysis）进一步分析这些因素之间的关联。研究结果表明，日常肉类消费者更倾向于选择年龄在1岁以下、体重在25–35公斤之间的羔羊，且价格范围在150万至210万印尼盾之间的产品。这一发现表明，在日常肉类消费市场中，养殖效率在很大程度上取决于羔羊的年龄和产品的价格竞争力。本研究为基于细分市场的畜牧业营销策略制定提供了有益的参考。。

papers.title: Differentiable Bilevel Programming for Stackelberg Congestion Games
papers.abstract:
In a Stackelberg congestion game (SCG), a leader aims to maximize their own gain by anticipating and manipulating the equilibrium state at which the followers settle by playing a congestion game. Often formulated as bilevel programs, large-scale SCGs are well known for their intractability and complexity. Here, we attempt to tackle this computational challenge by marrying traditional methodologies with the latest differentiable programming techniques in machine learning. The core idea centers on replacing the lower-level equilibrium problem with a smooth evolution trajectory defined by the imitative logit dynamic (ILD), which we prove converges to the equilibrium of the congestion game under mild conditions. Building upon this theoretical foundation, we propose two new local search algorithms for SCGs. The first is a gradient descent algorithm that obtains the derivatives by unrolling ILD via differentiable programming. Thanks to the smoothness of ILD, the algorithm promises both efficiency and scalability. The second algorithm adds a heuristic twist by cutting short the followers’ evolution trajectory. Behaviorally, this means that instead of anticipating the followers’ best response at equilibrium, the leader seeks to approximate that response by only looking ahead a limited number of steps. Our numerical experiments are carried out over various instances of classic SCG applications ranging from toy benchmarks to large-scale real-world examples. The results show that the proposed algorithms are reliable and scalable local solvers that deliver high-quality solutions with greater regularity and significantly less computational effort compared with the many incumbents included in our study.
                  Funding: This research is funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China’s Young Scientists Fund (Type C) [Grant 72501242], the U.S. National Science Foundation’s Civil Infrastructure System Program [Grant CMMI 2225087], and the Energy, Power, Control, and Networks Program [Grant ECCS 2048075].
                  Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/trsc.2026.0233 .
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Differentiable Bilevel Programming for Stackelberg Congestion Games。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Computer science、Mathematical optimization、Bilevel optimization」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。研究方法：机器学习、实验方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: REGULATORY CHALLENGES OF STABLE COINS: IMPLICATIONS IN THE CONTEXT OF FINANCIAL STABILITY
papers.abstract: The increasing growth of stablecoins has opened great opportunities for new financial originations while adding considerable challenges for regulation and supervision of finances. Among the cryptocurrency market and digital services stablecoins maintain a steady value in connection to a reference asset, most frequently a fiat currency. The increasing growth of stable coins and its implementation in businesses and financial institutions have raised concerns with liquidity, redemption, de-pegging, reserve management, operatio­nal risks and systemic effects. The global reach of stablecoin further complicates regulatory actions and open prospects for regulatory speculations. This study focuses on the main regulatory and supervisory issues connected with stablecoin and its potential implications for financial stability.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】稳定币的快速增长为新金融产品的创新带来了巨大机遇，同时也给金融监管带来了严峻挑战。在加密货币市场和数字服务领域，稳定币通常与某种参考资产（最常见的是法定货币）保持稳定的价值。随着稳定币的普及及其在企业和金融机构中的广泛应用，人们开始关注其流动性、赎回机制、与参考资产脱钩的可能性、储备管理、运营风险以及潜在的系统性影响等问题。稳定币的全球影响力进一步加剧了监管工作的复杂性，并引发了关于监管政策的各种猜测。本研究重点探讨了与稳定币相关的关键监管与监督问题，以及这些问题对金融稳定性的潜在影响。。

papers.title: Network Indicators of Information Asymmetry in Fast Trading Markets
papers.abstract: Although information technology has revolutionized trading and delivered substantial gains in efficiency and responsiveness, it has also produced an adverse side effect: episodes of intensified informed trading, of which flash crashes are the most visible manifestation. The structural conditions that distinguish markets undergoing such episodes from calmer ones remain incompletely understood. This paper contributes to closing that gap by establishing a set of network metrics that capture how the topology of the trading network reorganizes in response to information asymmetries. These market configurations refer to the evolving structure of trading activity, shaped by the distribution of participants, their interactions and the timing of information flow. To this purpose, we use an agent‐based model to analyze crucial aspects of market dynamics that traditional analytical models struggle to capture, namely the sudden changes in the topology of the market network that reflect shifts in trading behavior or connectivity. We find that the proposed network metrics correlate strongly with standard indicators of order‐flow toxicity, confirming that shifts in market topology reliably reflect the underlying levels of adverse selection and informed trading.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】尽管信息技术彻底改变了交易方式，并在效率和响应速度方面带来了显著提升，但它也产生了一个负面效应：即知情交易的加剧，其中“闪崩”（flash crashes）是最明显的表现形式。目前，我们尚未完全理解导致市场出现这种剧烈波动的结构性因素。本文通过建立一套网络指标来填补这一研究空白，这些指标能够反映交易网络在信息不对称情况下的重组过程。这些市场配置体现了交易活动的演变结构，其形成受到参与者分布、他们之间的互动方式以及信息流动时序的影响。为此，我们采用了基于代理的建模方法来分析传统分析模型难以捕捉的市场动态关键方面，尤其是那些反映交易行为或网络连通性变化的市场网络拓扑结构突变。研究结果表明，所提出的网络指标与衡量订单流毒性的标准指标之间存在高度相关性，这进一步证实了市场拓扑结构的变化能够可靠地反映潜在的不利选择行为和知情交易现象。。

papers.title: A Study on the Impact of Non-agricultural Use of Agricultural Land in Shandong Province on Economic Growth
papers.venue: Journal of Economics and Public Finance
papers.abstract: China's farmland has been shifted to factories, roads, and housing faster than at any point in its history—and Shandong has been at the front of that wave. The conversion helped push the province's GDP up for years, but it has also eaten into grain acreage, strained the Yellow River basin's ecology, and left displaced rural households with few alternatives, costs that now gnaw at the very growth it fed. Given the needs of urbanization and industrialization, it is essential to effectively address the negative impacts of farmland non-agriculturalization while meeting the demand for expanded land use. To ensure that farmland non-agriculturalization promotes economic growth and urbanization in certain regions, it is crucial to clarify the relationship between the two and implement appropriate measures to manage related challenges. Taking Shandong Province as a case study, this paper investigates the relationship between farmland non-agriculturalization and economic growth. Using a combination of literature review and empirical research methods, we collected 20 years of data from Shandong and applied the C-D production function model to analyze the contribution of farmland non-agriculturalization to economic growth, concluding that it is a significant factor. The pace of farmland non-agriculturalization in Shandong has been rapid, with a substantial increase in the proportion of non-agricultural land use, making it a major engine of economic growth. This transformation has promoted industrialization and urbanization, stimulated investment and consumption, created employment opportunities, improved living standards, increased tax revenues, and driven optimization and upgrading of the industrial structure. By calculating the contribution rate of farmland non-agriculturalization to economic growth, we derive conclusions and propose recommendations for sustainable development based on local conditions. These suggestions aim to prevent minor problems from escalating and avoid over-reliance on farmland non-agriculturalization, which could lead to negative consequences such as reduced arable land, heightened food security risks, ecological damage, employment and social insurance challenges, and illegal non-agricultural land occupation in some areas.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】中国的耕地转换速度之快，超过了历史上任何时期，其中山东省处于这一进程的最前沿。这种转变多年来推动了该省的GDP增长，但同时也减少了粮食种植面积，加剧了黄河流域的生态压力，导致大量农村家庭失去生计，这些负面后果正在侵蚀原本由耕地转化带来的经济增长成果。鉴于城市化和工业化的需求，必须在有效应对耕地非农化带来的负面影响的同时，满足土地使用的扩大需求。为了确保耕地非农化能够在某些地区促进经济增长和城市化，明确两者之间的关系并采取适当措施来管理相关挑战至关重要。以山东省为例，本文研究了耕地非农化与经济增长之间的关系。通过文献综述和实证研究方法，我们收集了山东省20年的数据，并运用C-D生产函数模型分析了耕地非农化对经济增长的贡献，得出结论认为其是推动经济增长的重要因素。山东省耕地非农化的进程十分迅速，非农用地比例大幅增加，成为经济增长的主要动力。这一转变促进了工业化和城市化进程，刺激了投资和消费，创造了就业机会，提高了生活水平，增加了税收收入，并推动了产业结构的优化与升级。通过计算耕地非农化对经济增长的贡献率，我们基于当地实际情况提出了可持续发展建议，旨在防止小问题演变成大问题，并避免过度...。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Capital Market Opening-up and High-Quality Innovation of Enterprises
papers.venue: Journal of Economics and Public Finance
papers.abstract: At present, China’s innovation field is facing the structural dilemma of quantity priority and insufficient quality. In the critical window period when the economy turns to high-quality development, the improvement of enterprise innovation level has become an important issue. Based on the quasi-natural experimental scenario of capital market opening, this paper constructs a multi-period difference-in-differences model to test the effect of capital market opening on the quality of enterprise innovation. Both theoretical deduction and empirical test show that capital market opening helps to improve the quality of enterprise innovation, and this effect is more significant in state-owned enterprises and enterprises with overseas business income. From the perspective of mechanism, on the one hand, the opening of capital market promotes the improvement of innovation quality by improving corporate governance and alleviating financing bottlenecks ; on the other hand, due to the increase of stock liquidity, the quality of innovation is suppressed. Overall, the positive effect is dominant. This paper not only expands the theoretical analysis of the relationship between capital market opening and enterprise innovation, but also provides a useful reference for policy practice.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：在中国经济转向高质量发展的背景下，资本市场开放对企业创新质量有何影响？

🔬 研究方法：利用资本市场开放的准自然实验，构建多期双重差分模型进行实证检验。

📊 核心发现：资本市场开放有助于提升企业创新质量，且在国有企业和拥有海外业务收入的企业中更为显著；机制分析显示，改善公司治理和缓解融资瓶颈的正面效应占主导地位。

💡 应用价值：扩展了资本市场开放与企业创新关系的理论分析，并为相关政策实践提供了参考。

papers.title: From r* to monetary policy stance: Evidence from Poland
papers.venue: Research Papers in Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This paper estimates Poland’s time-varying natural real interest rate and natural-rate gap over 2010Q1–2025Q1 and examines how a natural-rate-gap innovation propagates in a Structural Vector Error Correction (SVEC) framework. The measurement stage uses a Laubach-Williams-type state-space model disciplined by an ex ante real policy rate constructed from survey-based inflation expectations. The transmission stage embeds the estimated gap in a cointegrated macro-financial system covering activity, inflation, the real effective exchange rate, the term spread, debt-service costs and the natural-rate gap, with domestic and external controls. The estimated natural rate declines around the pandemic period and rises sharply during the post-pandemic tightening episode. Robustness analysis based on alternative expectations measures, GDP/GVA activity indicators, moderate calibration variants and one-sided filtering preserves the main cyclical profile, while highly flexible natural-rate specifications behave as diagnostic stress tests. SVEC results indicate bounded and weakly estimated transmission: statistically informative responses are sparse, CPI provides the clearest limited nominal evidence, and forecast-error-variance contributions remain small for most macro-financial variables. The natural-rate gap is therefore informative for monetary-stance assessment, but not a standalone explanation of Polish macroeconomic fluctuations.
papers.summary_zh: 【货币政策与宏观经济】本文估计了2010年第一季度至2025年第一季度期间波兰的自然实际利率及其与自然利率水平的差距，并探讨了在结构向量误差修正（SVEC）框架下这种自然利率差距变化如何传导。在测量阶段，采用了Laubach-Williams类型的状态空间模型，该模型以基于调查的通胀预期为基础来设定事前的实际政策利率。在传导阶段，将估计出的自然利率差距纳入到一个包含经济活动、通胀、实际有效汇率、期限利差、债务服务成本以及自然利率差距等变量的协整宏观经济系统中，并考虑了国内和国际因素的制约作用。研究发现，波兰的自然利率在疫情期间有所下降，而在疫情后的紧缩时期急剧上升。基于不同通胀预期指标、GDP/GVA活动指标、适度校准方法以及单边滤波技术的稳健性分析均证实了主要的经济周期特征；而高度灵活的自然利率设定则具有诊断性作用（即有助于评估经济体系的脆弱性）。SVEC模型的分析结果表明，自然利率差距的传导效应有限且较弱：统计上具有显著意义的传导信号较为稀少，CPI指标提供了最清晰的名义经济变量变化证据，且大多数宏观经济变量的预测误差方差贡献较小。因此，自然利率差距对于评估货币政策立场具有一定的参考价值，但无法单...。研究方法：误差修正模型、模型校准、调查数据。
